note: Medal frames behind Dining gifts, one per price tier, for the game-style showcase (owner review, 1 Nov 2026). The gift sits on the solid enamel disc in the centre. Test run only.

assets.subject: a round game achievement medal badge in warm polished copper, seen straight on
assets.details: A thick rounded copper rim with a soft bevel and two small leaf sprigs curling up the sides, around a smooth solid deep plum-brown enamel disc in the centre that is completely empty. Glossy metal highlights. Straight-on front view, symmetrical. No symbol, gem, number, words or object in the centre disc, no floating sparkles separate from the medal.
